description: This file contains Java integration test code for testing AMQP connection behavior in the Eclipse Hono project. It defines several test cases for verifying successful and failed connection scenarios for devices connecting via the AMQP protocol.

classes.name: AmqpConnectionIT
classes.description: Integration test class for AMQP connection behaviors, extending AmqpAdapterTestBase, with multiple JUnit test cases for connection success and failure scenarios.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test environment before each test, logging the current test method.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Cleans up the connection after each test if it was established.

methods.name: testConnectSucceedsForRegisteredDevice
methods.description: Tests successful connection for a registered device using correct credentials.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForNonExistingDevice
methods.description: Checks that connection is refused when a device that is not registered tries to connect.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForWrongCredentials
methods.description: Verifies that connection is refused when a device provides incorrect credentials.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForDisabledAdapter
methods.description: Ensures connection is rejected when the tenant's AMQP adapter is disabled.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForDeletedDevices
methods.description: Confirms that deleted device registration disables connection attempts.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForInvalidUsernamePattern
methods.description: Tests failure scenario when device username does not conform to expected pattern.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForNonMatchingTrustAnchor
methods.description: Verifies failure when device's certificate trust chain does not match tenant’s registered trust anchor.
